example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি তার ঈশ্বরের নাম জপ করেন প্রতিদিন সকালে।
এই ঘটনা তার মনে জপ করা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He chants his god's name every morning in constant remembrance.
This incident is etched in his memory as a constant reminder.
history: জপ is a practice derived from ancient Sanskrit texts and Hindu rituals, involving repetitive chanting of mantras for spiritual focus.
note: Primarily used in devotional contexts in Bengali culture.
